description_en: You can perform multimodal search based on person names, captions, and AI categorization
description_zh: 可以根据人名、字幕、AI分类进行多模搜索
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-media-by-ai-label --search-lib-name test-1 --media-type video --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --text Kite --multimodal-search-type Ocr --specific-search true --media-id 0000c469e944b5a856828dc20000 --matching-mode fuzzy --namespace name-1 --custom-filters intField1_:_gte_:12,_lte_:13_,_strField2_:_cd_,_de_,_strField1_:_abc --utc-create gte_:1761205662998,_lte_:1771205662998 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMediaByAILabel

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the media assets. Valid values:

- image

- video

- audio
parameters.help_zh:
媒资类型。取值：
- image：图片
- video：视频
- audio：音频
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en:
The sorting method of the results. Valid values:

- CreationTime:Desc (default): sorts results in reverse chronological order.

- CreationTime:Asc: sorts results in chronological order
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果排序。取值：

- CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
- CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The content that you want to query
parameters.name: text

parameters.help_en:
The type of query. Valid values:

- PersonName: queries media assets based on character names.

- Ocr: queries media assets based on subtitles.

- AiCategory: queries media assets based on AI categories.

- FullSearch (default): queries all media assets
parameters.help_zh:
多模搜索类型。默认为全文搜索。取值：

- PersonName：人名搜
- Ocr：字幕搜
- AiCategory ：AI分类
- FullSearch：全文搜
parameters.name: multimodal_search_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query media asset clips. Valid values:

- true

- false
parameters.help_zh:
是否精搜。取值：

- true： 精搜
- false：粗搜
parameters.name: specific_search

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset. This parameter is required if you want to query media asset clips
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
Matching pattern. The default value is fuzzy for Fuzzy Matching. Valid values:

- fuzzy: Fuzzy Matching

- precise: Precise matching. This pattern applies only to newly added media assets
parameters.help_zh:
匹配模式，默认为fuzzy模糊匹配。取值：

- fuzzy： 模糊
- precise：精确，该模式仅对新增媒资生效
parameters.name: matching_mode
custom_filters

parameters.help_en:
Creation time, in milliseconds UNIX timestamp. Use gte for greater than or equal to, and lte for less than or equal to.

- Example range: {"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间，毫秒时间戳。gte大于等于，lte小于等于。
- 范围，如{"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.name: utc_create
